measurement_policy: No missing measurement is represented by zero. Synthetic tests are not model accuracy.
timing_definition: total_ms includes model loading, audio extraction/diarization/features, visual identity, provider calls and indexing; excludes source cloning and the reused local keyframe scan. Cold means new process and empty application feature caches (OS/HF file cache uncontrolled). Warm means fresh analysis/index with retained local features and resident models; provider result caches are not copied. Provider service latency is uncontrolled. visual_model_load_ms is visual only; audio loading remains in diarization/embedding totals.
baseline_definition: old uses scene-chunks-v1 with frozen pre-identity prompts and no identity stage; it is a legacy-prompt baseline in the current executable, not the old commit binary.
